data.name: Kym
data.gender_notes: Kym is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Kymos was a river god. The name Kym comes from the Greek word kymē, meaning 'helper' or 'assistant'. In Christianity, this name can be interpreted as a reminder of God's presence and assistance in our lives. The name Kym carries the meaning “God's Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kym usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kym total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Κυμ
in_greek.meaning: Το Κυμ σημαίνει κύμα ή θάλασσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κυμ πιθανότατα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'κῦμα' που σημαίνει κύμα ή θάλασσα. Σε χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη σχέση του βαπτισμένου με το νερό της βάπτισης και τη νέα ζωή που του προσφέρει.
